title: Typing Letters
objective: Use the home row and correct finger placement to type letters without looking at the keyboard.
lessonSummary:
Good typing technique starts with your fingers resting on the home row — left hand on A S D F, right hand on J K L ; — and each finger owning a small set of nearby keys instead of you hunting across the keyboard. Your pointer fingers reach slightly further (to keys like G and H), your middle and ring fingers stay closer to home, and your thumbs handle the space bar.

It feels slower at first than "hunt and peck" typing, because you're building a new habit. Push through that — the accuracy and speed gains show up within days of consistent short practice, not weeks.

tasks.title: Practice — Typing Letters
tasks.instructions: Practise typing each letter of the alphabet using the correct finger for 5–10 minutes. Record your accuracy or write down which letters were hardest to reach without looking.
